sensor: 1/2.78" progressive scan RGB CMOS, 2.0 µm pixel
features: Modular AXIS F-Series sensor unit — requires a separate AXIS F91 Main Unit; power, storage, codecs and streaming are provided by the main unit
5 MP fisheye sensor with 185 horizontal field of view
Rugged sensor (NEMA 4X, IEC 61373) with SMA connector for vehicles and machinery
M12 lens mount, fixed IR-cut filter
Can be combined with up to three other sensor units on one main unit
release_notes: Specs per official Axis datasheet (datasheet-axis-f2137-re-fisheye-sensor-en-US-453115.pdf). Sensor unit only: power, storage, codecs, protocols and RTSP come from the paired AXIS F-series main unit, so no configs are recorded. consumption_w is the sensor unit's own max draw per datasheet. Datasheet gives no frame rate (shutter/frame rate per F91 main unit datasheet), so max_fps omitted.
